title: Certificate of Eligibility Terms - Entitlement, Charging Basis and Time Limits by Tier
content:
**Explanation of terms printed on the Certificate of Eligibility — Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education).**

Entitlement is the balance of training time a benefit can still pay for. A full Certificate of Eligibility grants it in months; it is held and moved in days, a month counting as 30 days. The terms below apply tier by tier.

| Tier | Months granted on a full certificate | How training is charged against entitlement | Most months usable across two or more chapters together | Years after release (or the eligibility event) before the benefit can no longer be used | Entitlement restored for a term cut short by school closure or program disapproval | Days before a term starts that a school may certify | Credit hours making full time in a standard undergraduate term |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Montgomery GI Bill - Selected Reserve (Chapter 1606) | 36 | By training time | 48 | 0 (no time limit) | Yes | 120 | 12 |
| Survivors' and Dependents' Educational Assistance (Chapter 35) | 36 | By training time | 48 | 0 (no time limit) | Yes | 120 | 12 |
| Montgomery GI Bill - Active Duty (Chapter 30) | 36 | By training time | 48 | 10 | Yes | 120 | 12 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 60% Benefit Level | 36 | By rate of pursuit | 48 | 0 (no time limit) | Yes | 120 | 12 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 70% Benefit Level | 36 | By rate of pursuit | 48 | 0 (no time limit) | Yes | 120 | 12 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 80% Benefit Level | 36 | By rate of pursuit | 48 | 0 (no time limit) | Yes | 120 | 12 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 90% Benefit Level | 36 | By rate of pursuit | 48 | 0 (no time limit) | Yes | 120 | 12 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 100% Benefit Level | 36 | By rate of pursuit | 48 | 0 (no time limit) | Yes | 120 | 12 |

**What the terms mean**

- *36 months* on a full certificate is 1080 days of entitlement at 30 days a month.
- *By rate of pursuit* (the Chapter 33 levels) and *by training time* (Chapter 30, Chapter 35 and Chapter 1606) name the two charging bases; each chapter is charged on its own basis only.
- *48 months* is a ceiling on the total used across every chapter a beneficiary holds, even though each chapter grants its own 36 months.
- *0 years* means no time limit applies to that tier; only Chapter 30 carries a 10-year figure.
- *120 days* is the earliest point, before a term's start, at which a school may certify that term.
- *12 credit hours* is the full-time standard for an undergraduate standard term.
